findings.title: CVE-2026-114204 record published by ASUS as CNA
findings.summary_md: The CVE record was published on 18 November 2026 at 02:01:45 UTC with ASUS as the assigning CNA and 0x0dee credited as the finder. It describes a hard-coded cryptographic key in ASUS Control Center Express that lets a remote user bypass authentication by forging a session token for an account with a recent valid login, giving administrative control of the management console and the clients it manages. The record scores CVSS 4.0 at 9.0 with vector AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:L/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H, lists affected versions as through v1.7.27, and cites the ASUS security advisory as its only reference. CISA ADP enrichment attached to the record rates exploitation as none and technical impact as total.

findings.title: CVE-2026-114202 record published by ASUS as CNA
findings.summary_md: The CVE record was published on 18 November 2026 at 02:02:25 UTC with ASUS as the assigning CNA and 0x0dee credited as the finder. It describes use of a hard-coded cryptographic key (CWE-321) in ASUS Control Center Express that lets a remote user gain administrative privileges through a forged authentication token. The record scores CVSS 4.0 at 10.0 with vector AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H and lists affected versions as through v1.7.27. CISA ADP enrichment on the record rates exploitation as none, automatable as yes and technical impact as total.

findings.title: CVE-2026-114205 record published by ASUS as CNA
findings.summary_md: The CVE record was published on 18 November 2026 at 02:02:15 UTC with ASUS as the assigning CNA and 0x0dee credited as the finder. It describes incorrect authorization in ASUS Control Center Express that lets a remote authenticated user with a low-privileged role create an administrator account and gain administrative control of the management console and its managed clients. The record scores CVSS 4.0 at 9.4 with vector AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H and lists affected versions as through v1.7.27. CISA ADP enrichment rates exploitation as none and technical impact as total.

findings.title: ASUS security advisory: Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent
findings.summary_md: ASUS published the Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent bulletin in its advisory feed at 10:29:54 +0800 on 18 November 2026, which is 02:29:54 UTC. The bulletin says versions earlier than v1.7.29 are affected and that exploitation could bypass authentication or improperly grant administrator-level access to the management console and the clients it manages. It lists CVE-2026-114202 at CVSS 4.0 10.0, CVE-2026-114204 at 9.0 and CVE-2026-114205 at 9.4. ASUS instructs users to install v1.7.29 or later, then use Select Function > Client Agent Updater on the target devices and verify the displayed agent version.

findings.title: GitHub Advisory Database entry for CVE-2026-114202
findings.summary_md: The GitHub Advisory Database published GHSA-h9mr-7752-ffhq for CVE-2026-114202 on 18 November 2026 at 03:30:23 UTC. It carries the ASUS description of a hard-coded cryptographic key in Control Center Express that allows a remote user to forge an authentication token and gain administrative privileges, and marks the advisory as critical severity and unreviewed. The advisory points to the ASUS security advisory as its reference.
